name: Camera picture
summary: The newest picture of a live camera, filling its panel (no margins, no grid), with how long ago it came.
help: Wire a live stream (a Telemetry block, or a block's telemetry) whose items, on the channel named below, carry {"image": "data:image/png;base64,..."}. The newest picture fills the whole panel, its proportions kept (resize the panel to change its size); a badge says Live and how long ago it came, grey when no picture has come for a while. Pixels: smooth, or sharp to see the camera's own pixels.

inputs.label: Pictures
inputs.help: Live items with an image (a data URL)

params.label: Channel
params.help: The stream channel with the pictures (empty: any item with an image)

params.label: Pixels
params.help: sharp: the camera's own pixels, as squares
